segments.text: All Gods teachings are practical, running into obedience. Idle notions and useless speculations are not learnt from God. As Gods creating words, so his teaching words are with effect: as when he said let there be light, and there was light: so when he saith to the soul, be comforted, be humbled; it is effectually comforted, Isa. 66. 13. it is humbled, Job 40. 4, 5. As God hath in nature made no creature in vain, so he speaks no word in vain: every thing which men hear, or learn from the Father is for use, practice and benefit to the soul.
